caption: The drawing features a single bicorne hat prominently centered on a plain, light beige background. The hat is predominantly black with a slight sheen and subtle texture suggesting a fur or felt material. It curves upwards on both ends, forming a crescent-like shape. Along the right front edge, there is a gold trim forming a triangular area, fastened by a round gold button at the lower corner. Inside this triangle, there is a detailed gold emblem depicting an eagle with outstretched wings, perched upon a background of black and gold elements that appear to be stylized feather decorations or cockades. The artist's signature, "James H.C. Vail," is written in small letters near the bottom right of the image. The composition is simple and uncluttered, with no other objects or details present.
title: Military Chapeau
